description: Figure: imelysin/peptidase M75 is the only neighbour class significantly enriched beside DUF1513 genes in a paired within-genome design
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
D=pd.read_csv("DUF1513_neighbourhood_enrichment.csv")
F=pd.read_csv("DUF1513_neighbourhood_fisher.csv")
lab={"imelysin_M75":"imelysin / peptidase M75","iron_or_haem":"iron or haem term",
     "cyt_c_or_px":"cytochrome c or peroxidase","TonB_dep_receptor":"TonB-dependent receptor"}
F=F.set_index("feature").loc[["imelysin_M75","iron_or_haem","cyt_c_or_px","TonB_dep_receptor"]].reset_index()
n=int(F.n.iloc[0])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.15,1]})
y=np.arange(len(F))[::-1]
ax[0].barh(y+0.19,F.hit_DUF1513/n*100,height=0.36,color="#b2182b",label="DUF1513 window (18 kb)")
ax[0].barh(y-0.19,F.hit_control/n*100,height=0.36,color="#999999",label="control window (18 kb, same replicon)")
for i,r in F.iterrows():
    ax[0].text(r.hit_DUF1513/n*100+1.5,y[i]+0.19,"%d/%d"%(r.hit_DUF1513,n),va="center",fontsize=9)
    ax[0].text(r.hit_control/n*100+1.5,y[i]-0.19,"%d/%d"%(r.hit_control,n),va="center",fontsize=9)
    star="exact p = %.3f"%r.mcnemar_p
    ax[0].text(60,y[i],star,va="center",fontsize=9,
               color=("#b2182b" if r.mcnemar_p<0.05 else "#555555"),
               fontweight=("bold" if r.mcnemar_p<0.05 else "normal"))
ax[0].set_yticks(y); ax[0].set_yticklabels([lab[f] for f in F.feature])
ax[0].set_xlabel("genomes with the feature in the window (%)")
ax[0].set_xlim(0,88); ax[0].legend(loc="lower right",fontsize=9,frameon=False)
ax[0].set_title("Genomic neighbours of DUF1513 across %d genera\npaired with random same-replicon control windows"%D.genus.nunique(),fontsize=10)

m=D[["t_imelysin_M75","c_imelysin_M75"]].astype(int).values
ax[1].imshow(m.T,cmap="Greys",vmin=0,vmax=1.6,aspect="auto")
ax[1].set_yticks([0,1]); ax[1].set_yticklabels(["DUF1513 window","control window"])
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(D))); ax[1].set_xticklabels(D.genus,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(D)):
    for j in range(2):
        if m[i,j]: ax[1].text(i,j,"+",ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=13,fontweight="bold")
ax[1].set_title("imelysin / peptidase M75 presence per genome\n5 discordant pairs, all in the DUF1513 direction",fontsize=10)
for s in ["top","right"]: ax[0].spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(F[["feature","hit_DUF1513","hit_control","n","odds_ratio","fisher_p","disc_b","disc_c","mcnemar_p"]].to_string(index=False))
